website_summary.name: Jarvis Voice Assistant Interface
website_summary.description: The website presents a sleek and modern interface for interacting with a voice assistant named JARVIS, featuring a minimalist design with interactive buttons and a clean chat area.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a simple yet elegant design centered around a chat interface. At the top, there's a header displaying the name "JARVIS" alongside a circular logo with a pulsating purple ring animation, suggesting an active listening state. To the right of the header, there are two buttons: one for toggling between light and dark modes and another for refreshing the page. Below the header is a large, empty chat area with a white background and soft shadows, designed to display messages exchanged with the voice assistant. At the bottom, there's a form containing a text input field labeled "Type your message..." and two buttons: one with a microphone icon for voice input and another with a send icon for submitting text messages.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to interact with the voice assistant JARVIS through both text and voice inputs. Users can type their queries into the text input field and submit them by clicking the send button. Alternatively, they can use the microphone button to activate voice recognition and speak their commands. The website also includes a mode toggle button for switching between light and dark themes and a refresh button to reload the page. The chat area is designed to dynamically display the conversation history between the user and JARVIS.

functionality_testing.name: Message Input Field Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Message Input Field correctly accepts and sends the typed message.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The chat interface is open and ready for input.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The message "Show me the time." should be displayed in the chat area. 7. Next Steps : Type the message "Show me the time." into the message input field.
procedure: Type "Show me the time." into the Message Input Field.
Verify that the message appears in the Chat Area.

functionality_testing.name: Microphone Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Microphone Button activates the voice input feature.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The microphone button is visible and clickable.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The spoken command should appear in the chat area, followed by JARVIS's relevant response.
procedure: Speak a command such as "What is the weather today?"
Verify that the spoken command appears in the Chat Area

functionality_testing.name: Send Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Send Button sends the message.
functionality_testing.preconditions: A message is typed in the Message Input Field.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The message should be sent and displayed in the chat area. 7. Next Steps : Wait for JARVIS's response to load.
procedure: Verify that the message appears in the Chat Area.

data_display_testing.name: Chat Area Background and Shadow Effects Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify the background color and shadow effects in the chat area using Chat Area Card.
data_display_testing.preconditions: The webpage is loaded and visible.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The chat area should have a clean white background with subtle shadows enhancing the message input box.
procedure: Hover over the Chat Area Card to inspect the background color and shadow effects.
Ensure the background is white with appropriate shadow effects around the message input box.

data_display_testing.name: Verify Chat Content Card Displays Messages Correctly
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Chat Content Card correctly displays the conversation history, including all messages sent and responses.
data_display_testing.coverage_element: Chat Content Card : (Card element displaying the conversation history, including the messages sent and responses).
data_display_testing.preconditions: The user is logged into the application and has previously sent at least one message.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The Chat Content Card should display all previous messages and responses accurately without any missing or incorrect information.
procedure: Step 1 : Log into the application and navigate to the chat interface.
Step 2 : Review the Chat Content Card to ensure all messages and responses are displayed correctly.

design_validation_testing.name: UI Design and Style Test: Header Color and Logo Animation
design_validation_testing.objective: To evaluate the color consistency and animation of the header text and logo using Header Card.
design_validation_testing.preconditions: The webpage is loaded and visible.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The header text should be black, and the logo should display a smooth purple ring animation.
procedure: Hover over the Header Card to observe the header text color and logo animation.
Verify the header text color matches the specified design guidelines.
Confirm the logo animation is a purple ring as expected.

element_requirement: 1. Message Input Field : Text input field where users type messages, with the placeholder "Type your message..."
2. Send Button : Button presumably to send the typed message, labeled with a send icon
3. Chat Content Card : (Card element displaying the conversation history, including the messages sent and responses).
4. Microphone Button : Button for activating voice input.
